anisotropic_rate_contract.coordinate_map: X_parallel=x_parallel, X_perp=x_perp/c_perp maps the scalar action to Pprime[(partial_t pi)^2-|grad_X pi|^2]/2 with Pprime=2 A c_perp^2, transformed source velocity V=(v_parallel,v_perp/c_perp), and unchanged integrated point coupling j
anisotropic_rate_contract.emission_gate: the stationary retarded rate is nonzero only for V>1; V<=1 is assigned exactly zero
anisotropic_rate_contract.isotropic_normalization_check: Setting the transformed scalar speed to one reproduces the stationary scalar Franck-Tamm source-action form j^2 DeltaOmega^2/(16 pi P V) of the cited primary calculation.
anisotropic_rate_contract.power_scope: This is the infinite-stationary-track, constant-coefficient, classical point-source power with frequency-independent coefficients inside the frozen band. It is not valid above the first EFT, compositeness, recoil, background-variation, or source-coherence cutoff.
anisotropic_rate_contract.spectral_identity: for V>1, integral dOmega_n delta(V dot n-1)=2pi/V and integral_{kIR}^{kUV} k dk=(OmegaUV^2-OmegaIR^2)/2
anisotropic_rate_contract.stationary_power: dE/dt=-j^2 (OmegaUV^2-OmegaIR^2)/(16 pi Pprime V)=-E^2(1+v^2)^2(OmegaUV^2-OmegaIR^2)(1-2s)/(32 pi Mpl^2 s V)

frozen_local_action_contract.background: constant local Einstein-frame Minkowski metric, Ubar^mu=(1,0,0,0), varphi=0, constant spacelike scalar gradient along x_parallel, Wbar=0, alpha>0, and 0<s<1/2
frozen_local_action_contract.noether_energy: u=A pi_t^2+A pi_parallel^2+C |grad_perp pi|^2 and S_parallel=-2A pi_t pi_parallel, S_perp=-2C pi_t grad_perp pi
frozen_local_action_contract.quadratic_density: L2=A (partial_t pi)^2-A (partial_parallel pi)^2-C |partial_perp pi|^2+J pi, with A=2 alpha^2 s(1-s)/(1-2s)^2 and C=alpha^2 s/(1-2s)
frozen_local_action_contract.scope: The scalar-only quadratic Noether current is exact on this frozen external-coefficient block. Lower-order metric-vector mixing, recoil, coefficient gradients, source structure, and covariant gravitational energy are outside the rate theorem.
frozen_local_action_contract.source: J=-(alpha/Mpl)(T+2T_UU); for one physical point particle J amplitude has magnitude j=(alpha/Mpl) E(1+v^2)

limitations: OmegaIR is above the inverse coefficient-variation and finite-track scales; OmegaUV is below the earliest EFT, strong-coupling, compositeness, recoil, and source-resolution scale; OmegaUV is much smaller than E for the constant-trajectory approximation

The frozen scalar quadratic density has the exact positive Noether energy.

The transverse coordinate rescaling makes the spatial quadratic form isotropic.
The transformed canonical kinetic coefficient includes the exact Jacobian.
The universal metric point-particle scalar charge is exact.
The transformed source speed is the anisotropic dual-cone norm.
The transformed superluminal gate equals the predecessor threshold.
The retarded angular delta integral is exact for the open gate.
The stationary spectrum is quadratically cutoff dependent.
The transformed spectral measure matches the scalar Franck-Tamm normalization.
The exact anisotropic stationary scalar power follows from the transformed action.
Alpha cancels from the fixed-s cutoff-dependent rate.
The final power coefficient is exact.
Exact longitudinal motion is below threshold for a massive particle.
The ultrarelativistic universal-metric source remains nonzero.
The ultrarelativistic stationary power does not inherit trace suppression.
The physical-path small-loss fraction is exact.
The conditional cutoff inequality saturates the frozen survival fraction.
The rate factor diverges as one over s at the degenerate low-gradient boundary.
At fixed nonlongitudinal angle the rate vanishes only with the singular endpoint scaling.
A zero spectral band radiates zero power.
The ungated expression is never applied to the closed exact-longitudinal case.
The machine result is a local conditional rate and makes no observational exclusion.

primary_source_context.scope: Primary scalar-Cherenkov Franck-Tamm calculation. Its stationary isotropic point-source result fixes the retarded spectral normalization and quadratic UV-cutoff dependence used as an independent limit check; none of its cosmological model coefficients or observational examples is imported.

survival_contract.cutoff_inequality: DeltaOmega^2 <= 32 pi Mpl^2 s v V Fmax/[L E(1+v^2)^2(1-2s)] is necessary for the frozen stationary small-loss model to keep F<=Fmax
survival_contract.endpoint_limit: for fixed nonzero theta the same rate factor vanishes like 2(1-2s)^(3/2)/[v |sin(theta)|] only at the excluded singular s=1/2 endpoint
survival_contract.interpretation: The exact rate turns the earlier kinematic warning into a cutoff-dependent obstruction. It neither excludes the action nor establishes safety until the physical cutoff and path/background are independently fixed.
survival_contract.low_s_limit: the dimensionless rate factor (1-2s)/(s V) diverges like 1/[s v sqrt(2-cos^2(theta))]
survival_contract.small_loss_fraction: F=L E(1+v^2)^2 DeltaOmega^2(1-2s)/(32 pi Mpl^2 s v V) for V>1
survival_contract.ultrarelativistic_limit: as v approaches one at fixed nonzero theta, j approaches 2 alpha E/Mpl and F approaches L E DeltaOmega^2(1-2s)/(8 pi Mpl^2 s V)
